buildCmd: wibo cl.exe -c -nologo -W3 -WX- -Ox -Os -D _XBOX -D RB3E_XBOX -D RB3E -D NDEBUG -GF -Gm- -MT -GS- -Gy -fp:fast -fp:except- -Zc:wchar_t -Zc:forScope -GR- -openmp- -TC -I <LIBCMT> -Focrt.obj crt.c
externalDepsNote: DllMain is defined by RB3E source/xbox360.c (in the 51-obj set). crt.obj introduces ZERO new unresolved externals beyond it: no __u64tod, no libcmt div/mod helpers, no CRT startup deps.

verification.allRequiredDefined: every ledger Lane-C symbol present as a DEFINED external (COFF symbol-table scan)
verification.thunkBytesByteExact: std/ld save-restore words byte-for-byte identical to stock RB3Enhanced.dll thunk chain @0x8401b820 (std rN/ld rN + stw/lwz r12,-8(r1) + mtlr r12 + blr). Standalone full-body copies per entry symbol (rN..r31), semantically identical to the fall-through chain; formula cross-checked against extracted stock bytes.
verification.linkProbe: wibo link.exe -MACHINE:PPCBE -dll -entry:_DllMainCRTStartup -NODEFAULTLIB -OPT:NOREF crt.obj probe.obj -> rc=0, no unresolved externals, valid PE (machine 0x01f2, .text=9216B with all libc bodies linked). Entry _DllMainCRTStartup forwards to DllMain and returns TRUE (li r3,1; blr after ICF fold).

designNotes.thunks: Emitted via __declspec(naked) + __emit(word) (cl.exe X360 supports both for PPC; naked yields exact bytes with no prolog/epilog). Full 14..31 chain emitted (safe superset of ledger's 16,18,20,22,23,24,25,26,27,28,29).
designNotes.vararg: Uses toolchain <stdarg.h> (va_list_def.h). va_arg lowers to reads from the compiler's own homed GPR save area (lfd for doubles) -- caller-side variadic passing and callee-side va_arg are two halves of the same cl.exe ABI, hence self-consistent incl. FP. C4392 warning on __va_start is benign (intrinsic still lowers correctly).
designNotes.malloc: 8 MB static bump arena, 16-byte aligned; no free/realloc reclaim (free is resolved elsewhere -- not in ledger). Arena lives in .bss (no file bloat). Revisit only if a fault traces to exhaustion.
designNotes.printf: Subset covering RB3E's format strings: d i u x X o p c s f %% with flags(-+ space 0 #), width/precision (incl *), length hh/h/l/ll. 64-bit ints supported (%lli/%llx). %f kept 32-bit-integer/fraction (<=9 frac digits) to avoid the __u64tod helper.
designNotes.sscanf: Subset: whitespace, literal match, %d %i %u %x %o %s %c %f with h/l length and * suppression; covers %hu.%hu.%hu.%hu and %i.
designNotes._blkmov: MSVC-PPC inline-memcpy helper (-Os lowers counted copies to 'bl _blkmov'; dest=r3,src=r4,count=r5 confirmed from call-site). Defined as a forward byte copy; a plain byte loop does not self-lower, so no recursion.
designNotes.notDefined: strlen/strcmp/strcpy/strcat/strncmp/free/memmove intentionally omitted -- already resolved elsewhere in the link (absent from ledger category C); defining them would collide.

openRisks: %f FP correctness relies on cl.exe's self-consistent variadic ABI (caller homes the double where va_arg reads it). Low-priority path (~6 debug uses); integer/string/hex/pointer formats (the hundreds of real uses) are GPR/stack and fully correct.

The -RELEASE link flag triggers wibo's missing CheckSumMappedFile stub (imagehlp.dll) at PE-checksum time -- NOT a symbol issue and orthogonal to Lane C. The K-link join should drop -RELEASE (or checksum post-hoc; xex2pack recomputes anyway).
